note: Day 3 comparison set: the same thirteen questions through vanilla Helix, agentic RAG and GraphRAG. Each question is there because at least one architecture gets it wrong. Correct means every must_include string is present, no must_not_include string is present, and the refusal behaviour matches.

queries.kind: single fact, office and role stated
queries.text: I am the primary caregiver and I work in the Amsterdam office. How many working days of parental leave do I get?
queries.ground_truth: 130 working days (26 weeks), primary caregiver, Amsterdam office, HB-PAR-2024 v4

queries.kind: office implied by who is asking
queries.text: As the primary caregiver, how many weeks of parental leave do I get?
queries.ground_truth: 26 weeks: the user is contracted to Amsterdam (HB-PAR-2024 v4)

queries.text: Which office offers the longest primary caregiver parental leave?
queries.ground_truth: Amsterdam, 26 weeks (then Berlin 24, Dublin 18), HB-PAR-2024 v4

queries.kind: two facts joined on one entity
queries.text: I am the primary caregiver in the Amsterdam office with three years' service, and I plan to resign after my leave. How much parental leave do I get, and what notice must I give?
queries.ground_truth: 26 weeks (130 working days) of parental leave, then 1 month's notice (Amsterdam, 2 to 5 years). HB-PAR-2024 v4 and HB-EXIT v3

queries.text: How many weeks of parental leave does a secondary caregiver get in the Netherlands?
queries.ground_truth: 10 weeks (50 working days), secondary caregiver, Amsterdam office, HB-PAR-2024 v4

queries.text: What is the salary band for a senior engineer?
queries.ground_truth: Refuse and route to HR: HB-COMP-BANDS is hr-only

queries.text: How many weeks of paid parental leave do new parents get?
queries.ground_truth: It depends on the contracting office; HB-PAR-2024 v4 supersedes the 12-week global figure in HB-PAR-2022

queries.kind: question names a different office from the asker's
queries.text: What is the notice period if I resign from the Dublin office after three years?
queries.ground_truth: 6 weeks (Dublin, 2 to 5 years' service), HB-EXIT v3

queries.text: How many days of annual leave do I get each year?
queries.ground_truth: 25 days plus public holidays, HB-ANNUAL v5

queries.text: Can I claim a laptop stand on the home office allowance?
queries.ground_truth: Yes, within the one-off 600 EUR allowance, HB-EXP-HOME v2

queries.kind: nuance inside a topic the graph covers
queries.text: Can I spread my parental leave over several months if I work in the Amsterdam office?
queries.ground_truth: Yes: Amsterdam employees may spread the entitlement over the first twelve months, HB-PAR-2024 v4
queries.expected_evidence: spread the entitlement over the first twelve months

queries.kind: office implied, second caregiver role, Berlin
queries.text: How many weeks of parental leave do I get as the secondary caregiver?
queries.ground_truth: 8 weeks (40 working days): the user is contracted to Berlin, HB-PAR-2024 v4

queries.kind: office the current policy does not cover
queries.text: I work in the London office. How many weeks of parental leave do I get?
queries.ground_truth: HB-PAR-2024 v4 has no London entry and the 12-week global figure in HB-PAR-2022 is superseded. Correct behaviour: say the policy does not cover it and route to HR.
